name: Arai Zenjiro
source:
The head honcho of the "Arai-gumi," a small-time yakuza group under Kobe Y-gumi's umbrella. 
Zenjirou has enlisted the services of Togetsu and his associates to pursue an objective, embarking upon a voyage to Sarubotoke Island. 
Exhibiting a flamboyant yet superficial character, he embodies the typical Kansai penchant for humor, demanding quality in jest.

"Man, I could clone myself a hundred times, and it still wouldn't be enough!"
